# jpegli legacy fixtures

Streams written by this package's encoder as released in jpegs v0.2.0,
before it became T.81 conformant. That encoder wrote 16 appended bits after
the SSSS=16 Huffman code (T.81 H.1.2.2 says none), and predictors 5 and 6
used truncating `/2` instead of an arithmetic shift. Files in this format
exist in the wild, so `Decode` decodes a 16-bit stream with the frozen legacy
decoder (`legacy.go`) when its SSSS=16 codes carry the legacy appended bits
(see `decodeAuto`).

Each `<name>.jpg` has its source image `<name>.pgm`. They were generated by
`generate.go.txt` (a `main` package built against jpegs v0.2.0, seed 356) and
each was checked to round-trip through the v0.2.0 decoder. libjpeg-turbo
`djpeg` does not reproduce the source of any `ssss16-*` stream: `p1`, `p5` and
`p7` contain SSSS=16 differences; `p6` (despite its name) contains none and
differs only in predictor 6 rounding, which no decoder can detect, so
`Decode` reads it as T.81. `random16-*` and `gradient8-*` are also valid T.81
streams.
